notes.title: Better Inspection Menus (Demo Version 0.4.02)
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Boardwalkers![/h2][p]Soooo I wanted a better way to customize products for BB.  In fact, I've been playing around with this idea that you can customize each shop's product for a while now.  So I finally added it. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/96f9f96cec26ee8c7ee1c9ece70a02fbea7f58f3.png"][/img][/p][p]Each shop's slider will modify the shop's product quality and thereby it's stats.  This allows players to dial in the shop depending on what you need.  Too much capacity?  Up the quality and charge more.  Too much demand?  Dial quality back and get people through quicker.  It's up to you! 

The ride and games inspection menu has been updated with a slider as well: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/aed086153592a166e5ea775f760dc3692233c5a7.png"][/img]For rides and games, you set the "thrill level" instead of the product quality.  [/p][p]You'll notice that each menu has a small image on the mid left under "Business Controls".  This image will change depending on the product quality/thrill level, just as an indicator for easy read. [/p][p]It's a step forward on the development roadmap to give you more control over your boardwalk! [/p][p]For this update, [b]it's highly recommended to start a new game[/b] as I've also encountered some issues with the old save system (which have been addressed!) [/p][h3]Full list of changes in 0.4.02:[/h3][p][b]Enhanced Inspection Menus for Businesses[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added product quality adjustment and ride thrill level adjustment on inspection menus. [/p][list][*][p]Adjusting product quality and ride thrill levels provides the player control over fine-tuning the product price, cost, visit rate, and other attributes of each individual shop.  [/p][/*][*][p]For shops and restaurants, this allows players to increase capacity to handle more visitors at the cost of revenue, or to decrease capacity when not needed and take advantage of more premium prices.  [/p][/*][*][p]For rides, this allows players to control the service time of the ride at the expense or benefit of the ride's cost.  [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Inspection menus now show "--" for product price for rides and games, indicating that rides and game do not make money for the player. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balancing Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the amount of experience required for boardwalk levels. [/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted visit rate rewards throughout the game - visit rate was increasing too fast in testing. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the cost to operate rides. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the cost to operate restaurants. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game could not load data due to incorrect building names being saved in data. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where customers would leave the boardwalk if the initial shop they wanted to visit was not available. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a tier mismatch error would appear when trying to combine two tier 2 buildings. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some save data issues that were causing buildings to save incorrect data. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo version 0.4.01 out now!
notes.notes: [h1]Hey all!  [/h1][p][/p][p]Just a small update today.  A new build of the game has been uploaded with a new feature that will hopefully make life easier.  I was noticing that a lot of players are missing messages from Erica, so I added a message history menu where you can see the last 10 messages she has said to you along with the helper icons:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/14ed99777385fec12c349549d93e3aea6887a11c.png"][/img][/p][p]This menu can be accessed by the lower left button on the main UI next to Erica's portrait: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/3e4df3da811a503b0608df5e531bb646f38570aa.png"][/img][/p][p]Clicking on it will bring up the menu, then you can either hover over the up and down arrows to scroll the menu, or use the mousewheel. [/p][p][/p][p]A full list of changes is below: [/p][p][/p][p]0.4.01[/p][p]⦁	Created a notification history menu to show previous notification messages.  The notification message history is accessible by clicking the Notification History button on the bottom left of the main UI.  The notification menu is scrollable by hovering over the up and down scroll buttons on the notification history UI, or by using the mousewheel. [/p][p]⦁	Corrected the size of the capacity icon when it's tutorial notification was being shown. [/p][p]⦁	Notification messages will now continue to show while the game is paused[/p][p]⦁	Added some additional tutorial messages[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks builders! [/p][p][/p][p]-Joel [/p]

notes.title: Version 0.4.0 Out Now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey builders! [/h2][p][/p][p]I've just launched version 0.4.0 this morning, and with it comes some awesome new changes to the game.  All of these changes are live in the demo, and you can check them out now! 
[/p][h3]New Combine Menu[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504134/c1dc3542cc655ff727d0f2e9e3f693f82d932d2d.png"][/img][/p][p]I wanted more readability for the combine function, and to make it more "fun".  This adds a marquee-style light for the combine menu, and makes it a bit cleaner. [/p][p][/p][h3]More build freedom[/h3][p]From the start of a new game, you'll be able to build any of the starting 7 tier 1 buildings instead of waiting to unlock them.  I'm hoping this will keep players more engaged.  [/p][p]
Full Change Notes: [/p][p]0.4.00[/p][p]⦁	Adjusted starting money to 1500 instead of 800[/p][p]⦁	Enabled building all tier 1 shops from the start of a new game[/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where reward cards wouldn't move out of the way when a bonus was selected to apply to a business[/p][p]⦁	Added new reward cards: [/p][p]⦁	Ride & attraction cost reduction[/p][p]⦁	Boardwalk visit rate increase[/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where you could run marketing campaign without selecting a campaign option first. [/p][p]⦁	Added an animation to the marketing confirm button. [/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where shop upgrades purchased through the inspection menu were not being saved correctly.[/p][p]⦁	Added a new button for marketing campaigns, and removed the marketing campaign tab from the Business Information menu [/p][p]⦁	Adjusted tutorials to provide additional instruction and focus on combine and marketing campaign buttons. [/p][p]⦁	Redesigned the Combine menu to be more compact and give it more of a boardwalk theme.  Added contrast in the menu for new stats for the combined building. [/p][p]⦁	Added tool tips to the combine menu stats when they are moused over.  [/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where you could start a campaign at 0 visit rate increase. [/p][p]⦁	Fixed an issue where the escape button would bring up the main menu when exiting certain other menus instead of going back to the game. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks![/p][p][/p][p]Joel [/p]
